title: SISO shell and template bank — parts re-sourced from the SISO design system hub

license.reason: SISO-owned work; no third-party licence applies. The component designs these parts follow come from the SISO design system hub (Lordsisodia/siso-knowledge, SISO_Knowledge/design-system), which is ours, and parts/SOURCES.md maps each part to its hub component and to the file and line each rule came from. The repository carries no LICENSE file, so no public redistribution grant is asserted to third parties.

evidence.summary: Parts rebuilt from the SISO design system hub (SISO_Knowledge/design-system, 3,567 components with installed source). The relationship map is a build-time tidy-tree graph layout taken from the hub's airbnb-linktypes (@visx/hierarchy, d3 Reingold-Tilford), adopting its sibling-vs-cousin separation ratio and its rule that a node's shape signals whether it leads anywhere; the gallery's bento cards, the catalogue search row, the metric strip and the rail's animated state icons each cite their hub component in parts/SOURCES.md. All 24 template families render their example, node --test passes 4/4, and every in-page anchor on all 24 example pages resolves to a real element id.
